existing_samples.status: 작동하는 C# 메쉬/네이티브 ParticleSystem 독립 샘플 구조; 게임에 자동 연결되지 않은 preview 전용. 런타임 품질 검증 완료를 의미하지 않음
existing_samples.activate: enabled/active로 재생하지 않음; CombatVfxSample.Play 명시 호출
existing_samples.moving_visual: Visual_Travel 내부를 _travelSpeed * min(t,_travelDuration)만큼 이동; gameplay projectile root와 함께 움직이면 이중 이동
existing_samples.extra_vertical_offset: 생성기의 Visual_Travel 초기 Y는 Dash .95 / Slash1.05 / Missile1.1 / Explosion.82; 이미 어깨/충돌 높이에 spawn하는 스킬 아래 넣으면 이중 높이 오프셋
existing_samples.sampling: SetPreviewTime은 고정 60Hz 수동 ParticleSystem.Simulate, deterministic seeds; native game loop로 전환 시 중복 시뮬레이션 피할 것
existing_samples.shader: URP custom transparent; ZTest LEqual, ZWrite Off, Cull Off, mesh vertex color+_Tint; external texture/distortion/light/collision 없음
integration_risks: SkillAutoRelease.lifeTime default .3 and SkillExplosion.lingerTime .3 truncate longer sample
SkillExplosion only SetActive(_blastVisual); preview sample will still require Play
VFX sample root is not SkillProjectile or SkillAutoRelease; typed Spawn/GetComponent expects root component
physical/magic shared teal needs shape/color role adjustment, generic asset pack must similarly standardize
maxParticles/renderers/triangles are composition counts, not GPU/CPU measured performance

current_skills.uncertainty: script notes design instant target-point AoE versus current flying projectile; design decision remains

pool.pool_capability: Generic PoolRequest/PreparePool, Rent activate=false, IsRented/Return supported
pool.proposal: Register VFX prefabs, rent inactive, assign transform/tint/radius, clear particles/trails, enable+Play, return once every child tail ended. Retain generation token/cancel outstanding callbacks.

handoff_contract.root: unit scale (1,1,1), pivot at gameplay hit/ground origin; Visual child owns asset remapping
handoff_contract.orientation: local +Z forward -> Quaternion.LookRotation(XY direction); billboard blast on camera plane; floor shape on XZ with vertical edge cue
handoff_contract.movement: gameplay SkillProjectile owns root translation; VFX no collision/no damage/no extra travel
handoff_contract.lifetimes: projectile until actual end/impact, field from Init until active data ends, blast after Detonate. Residual smoke detached or lifetime-aware release so parent cannot cut tail.
handoff_contract.damage: VFX never applies damage; current totalDamage split by count is gameplay's responsibility
